source: Measured: the privileged oracle (solution/oracle_policy.py, ground truth through the oracle token) reached all six delivery points on every scene of the hidden set (24 of 24, delivered_fraction 1.0 each), run once per scene through the robot service and the grader's ledger replay by the pre-registered selection (tests/review/hidden_set/RULE.md, selection.jsonl). An episode is a deterministic function of the scene and the requests, so every kept episode scores exactly what its selection run scored; full_at is 0.98.
